help: The functions that sort, format and split text by the rules of a language and region. The other classes in `Novis\Intl` call them for you, so most programs use those classes instead.

methods.name: collateOrder

params.name: options
params.type: {strength?: Strength, caseFirst?: CaseFirst, numeric?: bool, ignorePunctuation?: bool}

methods.help: Sorts strings by the rules of a locale. Returns the indexes of the strings in sorted order. Equal strings keep their order.

methods.name: sortKeys

params.name: options
params.type: {strength?: Strength, caseFirst?: CaseFirst, numeric?: bool, ignorePunctuation?: bool}

methods.help: Returns one sort key for each string. Two keys compare byte by byte in the same order as their strings sort in the locale.

methods.name: formatNumbers

params.name: options
params.type: {style: NumberStyle, minFractionDigits?: uint, maxFractionDigits?: uint, grouping?: bool, currency?: string, currencyDisplay?: CurrencyDisplay, compactDisplay?: CompactDisplay}

methods.help: Formats numbers, each given as its decimal text, in the style and locale you give.

methods.name: pluralCategories
methods.help: Returns the plural category of each number, each given as its decimal text, in the locale.

methods.name: formatDateTimes

params.name: values
params.type: array<{year: int, month: int, day: int, hour: int, minute: int, second: int, nanos: int, offsetSeconds: int, zone: string}>

methods.help: Formats dates with times of day, each given as its local fields, its UTC offset and its time zone, in the locale.

methods.name: formatDates
methods.help: Formats calendar dates in the locale.

methods.name: formatTimes
methods.help: Formats times of day in the locale.

methods.name: formatRelative
methods.help: Formats amounts of time before or after now, such as "in 3 days". A negative count is in the past.

methods.name: formatLists
methods.help: Joins the items of each list with the words of the locale, such as "a, b and c".

methods.name: wordSegments
methods.help: Splits each string into words, spaces and punctuation. Joined again, the parts of a string are the string.

methods.name: sentenceSegments
methods.help: Splits each string into sentences. Joined again, the sentences of a string are the string.

methods.name: resolveLocales
methods.help: Returns, for each locale tag, the locale whose data is used for the service. `und` means only the general rules are used.

methods.name: negotiate
methods.help: Returns the best of the offered locales for an `Accept-Language` header value. If no offered locale matches, it returns the default.

enums.name: Strength
enums.help: Which differences between two strings change their order. `Primary` compares letters only. `Secondary` also compares accents, and `Tertiary`, the default, also compares upper and lower case.

enums.name: CaseFirst
enums.help: Whether uppercase or lowercase letters sort first. `Off`, the default, uses the order of the locale.

enums.name: NumberStyle
enums.help: How `Icu::formatNumbers` writes a number. Each `NumberFormat` method uses one style.

enums.name: CurrencyDisplay
enums.help: How a currency is written: as its symbol, such as "US$", as its short symbol, such as "$", or as its name. The default is `Symbol`.

enums.name: CompactDisplay
enums.help: How a compact number is written: "1.2K" is `Short`, the default, and "1.2 thousand" is `Long`.

enums.name: PluralKind
enums.help: Which plural rules `Icu::pluralCategories` uses: the rules for counting, such as "3 items", or the rules for places, such as "3rd".

enums.name: PluralCategory
enums.help: A plural category of the locale. `PluralRules` returns these as `Core\Cldr\PluralCategory`.

enums.name: Length
enums.help: How long a formatted date is. The default is `Medium`.

enums.name: ZoneStyle
enums.help: How a formatted date and time shows its time zone: not at all, as its UTC offset, as a place, or as the name of the zone. The default is `None`.

enums.name: TimeUnit
enums.help: The unit of an amount of time in `RelativeTime::format`.

enums.name: Width
enums.help: How many words a formatted text uses. `Wide`, the default, writes words in full.

enums.name: Numeric
enums.help: Whether a relative time is always written with a number. `Always`, the default, writes "in 1 day". `Auto` writes "tomorrow".

enums.name: ListType
enums.help: The words that join a list: "a, b and c" is `And`, the default, "a, b or c" is `Or`, and `Unit` joins amounts such as "3 feet, 7 inches".

enums.name: Service
enums.help: The data `Icu::resolveLocales` checks: the rules for sorting, numbers, plurals, dates, relative times, lists or splitting text.
